title: Grilled Kebabs with Zesty Onion
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish featuring marinated kebabs with a zesty twist from caramelized onions.

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.notes: zest from 1/4 of the onion for marinade

instructions: 2. Peel and zest 1/4 of the onion, mixing with marinade from Syrian Kebabs package.
3. Thread kebabs and caramelized onion onto skewers.
4. Brush kebabs with remaining marinade and cook for 8-10 minutes per side.
5. Serve hot with additional zesty seasoning if desired.
